name: Jaya Tiasa Holdings Berhad
overview: 2026财年，集团没有新增或退出业务线，主要动态是季度产量披露：油棕板块鲜果串和原棕油产量在部分季度同比上升，木材板块原木产量在多个季度同比增加。此外，与关联方Borneo Edible Oils Sdn Bhd的经常性关联交易实际金额超出此前披露的估计值，原因是PGEO Group Sdn Bhd收购了Borneo Edible Oils 51%股权后采购安排发生变化。
overview_en: In FY2026, the Group did not add or exit any business lines. The main developments were quarterly production disclosures: fresh fruit bunch and crude palm oil production in the oil palm segment increased year-on-year in some quarters, while log production in the timber segment increased year-on-year in several quarters.

segments.name: 油棕
segments.note: 今年持续披露月度及季度鲜果串、原棕油和棕仁产量，部分季度产量同比上升。
segments.note_en: The segment continued to disclose monthly and quarterly fresh fruit bunch, crude palm oil and palm kernel production, with some quarters showing year-on-year increases.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : RECURRENT RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 向关联方Borneo Edible Oils Sdn Bhd销售原棕油和棕仁的经常性关联交易实际金额为RM799,849,252，超出估计值RM650,000,000约23%，原因是PGEO Group Sdn Bhd收购Borneo Edible Oils 51%股权后采购安排发生变化。
actions.text_en: The actual value of recurrent related party transactions for the sale of crude palm oil and palm kernel to Borneo Edible Oils Sdn Bhd was RM799,849,252, exceeding the estimated value of RM650,000,000 by about 23%, due to a change in purchasing arrangements fol…

actions.title: DISCLOSURE ON QUARTERLY PRODUCTION
actions.text: 2026年9月季度原棕油产量69,212公吨，同比增加18%；鲜果串产量292,118公吨，同比增加10%；棕仁产量16,026公吨，同比增加26%。
actions.text_en: For the quarter ended September 2026, crude palm oil production was 69,212 MT, up 18% year-on-year; fresh fruit bunch production was 292,118 MT, up 10%; palm kernel production was 16,026 MT, up 26%.

actions.title: DISCLOSURE ON QUARTERLY PRODUCTION
actions.text: 2026年6月季度原棕油产量48,537公吨，同比减少1%；鲜果串产量195,240公吨，同比减少10%；棕仁产量10,423公吨，同比减少4%。
actions.text_en: For the quarter ended June 2026, crude palm oil production was 48,537 MT, down 1% year-on-year; fresh fruit bunch production was 195,240 MT, down 10%; palm kernel production was 10,423 MT, down 4%.

actions.title: DISCLOSURE ON QUARTERLY PRODUCTION
actions.text: 2026年3月季度原棕油产量42,401公吨，同比增加1%；鲜果串产量188,928公吨，同比减少10%；棕仁产量9,696公吨，同比增加1%。
actions.text_en: For the quarter ended March 2026, crude palm oil production was 42,401 MT, up 1% year-on-year; fresh fruit bunch production was 188,928 MT, down 10%; palm kernel production was 9,696 MT, up 1%.

actions.title: DISCLOSURE ON QUARTERLY PRODUCTION
actions.text: 2025年12月季度原棕油产量70,321公吨，同比增加13%；鲜果串产量310,247公吨，同比增加7%；棕仁产量16,193公吨，同比增加18%。
actions.text_en: For the quarter ended December 2025, crude palm oil production was 70,321 MT, up 13% year-on-year; fresh fruit bunch production was 310,247 MT, up 7%; palm kernel production was 16,193 MT, up 18%.

segments.name: 木材
segments.note: 今年持续披露月度及季度原木产量，多个季度原木产量同比增加。
segments.note_en: The segment continued to disclose monthly and quarterly log production, with log production increasing year-on-year in several quarters.

actions.title: DISCLOSURE ON QUARTERLY PRODUCTION
actions.text: 2026年9月季度原木产量32,076立方米，同比增加44%。
actions.text_en: For the quarter ended September 2026, log production was 32,076 cubic metres, up 44% year-on-year.

actions.title: DISCLOSURE ON QUARTERLY PRODUCTION
actions.text: 2026年6月季度原木产量23,447立方米，同比减少7%。
actions.text_en: For the quarter ended June 2026, log production was 23,447 cubic metres, down 7% year-on-year.

actions.title: DISCLOSURE ON QUARTERLY PRODUCTION
actions.text: 2026年3月季度原木产量30,729立方米，同比增加72%。
actions.text_en: For the quarter ended March 2026, log production was 30,729 cubic metres, up 72% year-on-year.

actions.title: DISCLOSURE ON QUARTERLY PRODUCTION
actions.text: 2025年12月季度原木产量28,382立方米，同比增加2%。
actions.text_en: For the quarter ended December 2025, log production was 28,382 cubic metres, up 2% year-on-year.
